description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] Send every waiting (queued) item id exactly once, in the new order. Booked, posted, failed and skipped items keep their places. Needs the `publish` scope (or admin) on the Agency plan or higher.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/queues/{id}/items/reorder.)
name: reorder_queue_items
title: Reorder waiting queue items
